nodes.name: Working Overtime
nodes.text: Increases your chance to gain a skill increase from using any primary, secondary, or class-based tradeskill by 10%.

nodes.name: Bountiful Harvest
nodes.text: You are 100% more likely to discover Scarce materials from Mining, Herbalism, and Skinning.

nodes.name: Master Chef
nodes.text: Your cooking recipes have a 30% chance to create an extra result.

nodes.name: Bartering
nodes.text: Reduces the gold price of items from all vendors by 10%.

nodes.name: Performance Bonus
nodes.text: You have a 15% chance to receive 100% increased Merchant's Favor when you turn in a crate to the Azeroth Commerce Authority or Durotar Supply and Logistics.

nodes.name: Luremaster
nodes.text: While fishing with a Lure active, you have a 50% chance to catch an extra fish.

nodes.name: Dedicated Study
nodes.text: Increases your skill by 1 in your lowest tradeskill among your Primary and Secondary tradeskills. If you have already reached 300 skill in your two current Primary Tradeskills and all three Secondary Tradeskills, you will gain 2 to 4 of a random Elemental Essence.

nodes.name: Unknown
nodes.text: To be added in a future update.

nodes.name: Unknown
nodes.text: To be added in a future update.

nodes.name: Well Rested
nodes.text: Your rested experience accumulates 20% faster and your rested experience cap is increased by 20%.

nodes.name: Thrill of Adventure
nodes.text: You gain 5% of your maximum Health and Mana over 10 sec each time you deliver the killing blow to a non-trivial enemy. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds.

nodes.name: High Alert
nodes.text: Increases your ability to detect nearby targets with Stealth as if your level were increased by 2. Ineffective in Battlegrounds.

nodes.name: Talented
nodes.text: You gain talent points every level starting at level 5 instead of starting at level 10, but you still may not have more than 51 total talent points.

nodes.name: Field Guide
nodes.text: Reduces your cooldown on adding Camp features by 25%

nodes.name: Field Medicine
nodes.text: Reduces the duration of the Recently Bandaged effect by 10 sec when you use a bandage. Ineffective in dungeons, raids, and battlegrounds.

nodes.name: Unknown
nodes.text: To be added in a future update.

nodes.name: Frequent Flier
nodes.text: You receive a 50% discount on all flight paths, and your flight path mount flies 20% faster.

nodes.name: Unknown
nodes.text: To be added in a future update.

nodes.name: Gourmand
nodes.text: Increases the duration of beneficial effects from eating food by 100%.

nodes.name: The Quick and the Dead
nodes.text: Increases movement speed while dead by 10% and your helpful spells and abilities cost no resources for 2 min after being resurrected or until you enter combat.

nodes.name: Reinforce
nodes.text: You take 20% less durability loss when you die.

nodes.name: For Great Honor
nodes.text: Increases Honor Points gained by 10%.

nodes.name: Permanence
nodes.text: Your class abilities which grant long-duration stat or attribute benefits to all party or raid members last 100% longer, and the benefits you gain from resting at a camp last 50% longer.

nodes.name: Diplomat
nodes.text: Increases your reputation gains by 10%.

nodes.name: Unknown
nodes.text: To be added in a future update.

nodes.name: Reagent Economy
nodes.text: Your class abilities no longer require reagents purchaseable from vendors.

nodes.name: Unknown
nodes.text: To be added in a future update.
